# TerrainNeeds

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/physics/physics_sys.h`](../../../src/physics/physics_sys.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

Boxes that need terrain colliders this frame without a dynamic body in them

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `boxes` | `std::vector<std::pair<glm::vec3, glm::vec3>>` | min, max |

## Notes

Filled every frame by the player legs, emptied by TerrainColliders.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: PlayerLegs, TerrainColliders. Created by: PlayerLegs. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [PlayerLegs](../systems/PlayerLegs.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create** | tick | created when missing; appends a box per player from 1.5 m around the eyes down to height + reach + 1.5 m below, so TerrainColliders meshes the ground under the legs |
| [TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | boxes taken into the required set, then cleared |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[PlayerLegs](../systems/PlayerLegs.md)**
  - At each 60 Hz physics step (FixedSteps.before): a narrow phase ray cast per player, `AddForce` of the stand, walk and jump forces, `ActivateBody`.
  - Sets the collision group of the player's body once (`SetCollisionGroup`).
- **[TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in sorted cell order (deterministic).
  - Taskflow for_each (waited) over new required cells and silent_async prefetch jobs; zone Build collider cell.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit (throws when missing).
  - Log warning 'Terrain collider : ...' when Jolt refuses a mesh.
